Insert text. Caps Shift + letter gives uppercase.
Symbol Shift + 1 / C / V / T / Z
Type ! / ? / slash / > / colon. These are punctuation, not edit commands.
Symbol Shift + M / N / O / P
Type period / comma / semicolon / quotation mark.
Both Shifts, then release (Fuse: tap Tab)
Left / right / up / down. Fuse arrow keys provide these chords.
Jump to document start / end. On hardware, use both Shifts + 5 / 8.
Page up / down (ten layout lines). On hardware, use both Shifts + 7 / 6.
Pan wide ECM view left / right. Narrow pages do not pan.
Hold PC Shift first, then an arrow (Fuse)
Start selecting. Further arrows keep extending the selection after Shift is released.
Start persistent selection using the menu; useful on a physical TS2068.
Caps Shift + Space; Edit → Clear selection
Clear the selection without deleting text. Applying a style also clears it.
Cut / paste. Both Shifts + X / Y also work.
Copy / undo. Up to five undo states, space permitting.
Search forward, ignoring case, with wraparound. Enter repeats the previous query; Caps Shift + Space cancels.
Symbol Shift + F / E / W / S / I
File / Edit / View / Style / Insert. Both Shifts also work.
Navigate; activate; dismiss. Help/About also provide Enter to continue or return.
Hold both Shifts + Q / A / O / P
Move up / down / left / right. Fuse Tab holds both emulated Shifts.
Click. Keep held and move with Q/A/O/P to drag a selection.
Arrows; hold Shift first, then arrow
Move the crop rectangle by 8 pixels; resize the active corner.
Enter; C or Caps Shift + Space; H
Insert crop; cancel crop; show/hide crop instructions.
Start loading/saving/exporting; abort an active tape transfer.
